title: Waikiki Turtle Snorkeling Adventure(8am)
includes: Water (hot & cold), lemonade, coffee and tea
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children under 2 years old can come aboard for free, but they need to be accompanied by an adult.
policies: Consider taking sea sickness medication if you are prone to motion sickness or are not accustomed to being on catamaran
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover an all-in-one Waikiki ocean adventure with our Turtle Snorkeling Tour. Cruise aboard our spacious and comfortable catamaran to Turtle Canyon, where you’ll have the opportunity to snorkel with Hawaiian green sea turtles and colorful tropical fish in their natural habitat.

Enjoy more than snorkeling with stand-up paddleboarding, kayaking, sea scooters, and swimming—all included at no additional cost.

First-time snorkelers and less-confident swimmers are welcome. Life jackets are provided, and our experienced crew can assist guests in the water using flotation boards for additional support.

After your ocean activities, relax aboard the catamaran with complimentary snacks and drinks while enjoying beautiful views of Waikiki and Diamond Head.

With multiple ocean activities, friendly crew assistance, and Hawaii’s incredible marine life, this tour is a memorable Waikiki adventure for families, couples, and friends.
